Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent sprite sheet of16 hand-drawn PAINT powers effects for Gelton, an arts teacher/capoeira fighter in a classic 2D arcade game. These are thick moving calligraphic BRUSHSTROKES and liquid PAINT splashes, not smoke, clouds, fire, electricity, lasers, floating words or generic glowing balls. Palette: vibrant hot magenta, turquoise/cyan, golden yellow and deep violet ink underside; bright cream highlight slashes. Crisp black-violet contours, sharp solid cel shading, very strong readable silhouettes, dynamic graphic streaks, no blur or soft glow.
Layout exactly4columns x4rows, large2048x2048 transparent RGBA sheet. Each cell separate within its cell with at least30px transparent gutter, no overlap, no labels, no numbers, no objects, no character.
Row1 four chronological loop frames of a right-traveling brushstroke projectile: fat compact jagged FAN OF PAINT at RIGHT pointing forward, three thin long curved tails trailing LEFT. Whole stroke about350x160px at source scale, dense front about100px across. Magenta/yellow/cyan ribbons separated by ink contours, droplets in the wake. All4 frames same dense front position.
Row2 four one-shot contact frames: compressed angular cream contact slash and small paint droplets; then sharp expanding chromatic star-shaped SPLAT with thick liquid paint lobes; then expanding ragged splatter with smaller scattered drops; final isolated smaller irregular paint flecks with empty center. Same impact center everycel. Not flower, not explosive fire.
Row3 four consecutive frames of a huge upward CRESCENT painted by a sweeping capoeira leg: thick curved brush arc rising bottomleft to upperright, bright leading edge, torn dry-brush tapered start and scattered droplets. Open inner space, curve convex to RIGHT like ')'. At source scale roughly220wide x360high. Silhouette different across frames as arc evolves.
Row4 four build/release frames of a palm painting charge: small compact S-shaped ribbon; larger coiled colorful spiral; explosive RIGHT-FACING FAN of long brushstroke strips; dispersed thin fading curling strips/droplets. Same center, evolves size.
Every effect clean alpha edges, no checkerboard printed, no rectangular frames, no floor or shadows. This is unique vibrant PAINT visual language; not the smoke visual language of Gustavo.
